summary: In terms of diversity and inclusion if we are already talking about this in the HR department it is too late. We need to ensure equitable access but interventions can not be imposed on communities. Instead use the local web to celebrate and archive local knowledge. #ncte18
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: In terms of diversity and inclusion if we are already talking about this in the HR department it is too late. We need to ensure equitable access but interventions can not be imposed on communities. Instead use the local web to celebrate and archive local knowledge. #ncte18
